questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the correct form of the verb in brackets: By the time we arrived, the exhibition _____ already.
Which sentence correctly reports the statement: 'I have never seen such a beautiful sunset before.'?
options: 'I have never seen such a beautiful sunset before,' he said.
'I have never seen such a beautiful sunset before,' he said to me.
He said that he had never seen such a beautiful sunset before.
He said that he had never seen such a beautiful sunset before to me.
questions.answer: He said that he had never seen such a beautiful sunset before.

questions.question: Choose the best option to complete the sentence: If I _____ you, I would take that job.
Which of these sentences correctly uses the passive voice to report the action? The committee _____ the proposal for further discussion.
Select the correct option to complete the sentence: After the meeting, we decided _____ the presentation again.
Which sentence correctly uses the third conditional to report a past unreal condition? If he _____ harder, he _____ the exam.
Choose the correct collocation: It's important to maintain a good _____ with your colleagues.
Select the correct preposition to complete the phrase: He was reluctant _____ change his plans.
Which option correctly reports the meaning of the sentence: 'That report was incredibly detailed.'?
options: The listener said that the report was incredibly detailed.
The listener said that the report had been incredibly detailed.
The listener said that the report had been incredibly detailed.
The listener said that the report was incredibly detailed.
questions.answer: The listener said that the report was incredibly detailed.
